summary: Routing/locale helper functions built on the site constants module (`HoYoverseMi18n`, module 49) and a cookie library (module 40). It exports a matcher that tests a path against the configured path list (strings or RegExps), a route-name normalizer that falls back to the `lang` key, a builder that prefixes a path with the language segment (keeping or dropping the mobile `/m` prefix), a language resolver that validates against the supported locales or falls back to the `mi18nLang` cookie / default language, and a query sanitizer that strips the `catchSpider` key.

exports.a: isMatchedPath(path) — whether the path matches one of the configured route paths/regexes
exports.e: normalizeLangRouteName(name) — returns the name if it is a lang route name, otherwise the lang key
exports.c: buildLangPath(path, lang, dropMobilePrefix) — prefixes a path with /<lang> (and /m on mobile)
exports.d: resolveLang(lang) — supported lang or mi18nLang cookie or default lang
exports.b: omitCatchSpider(query) — copy of a query object without the catchSpider key
